comment: Digest pin for the vendored public-site styleguide (the gateway repo remains the authored authority; this copy is a vendor, repinned only by a deliberate edit to this record). Fold R8 correction (2026-10-02, critic F4): when the gateway branch merges, main's bytes will NOT be identical to these — gateway main has since reworded the component notes (measured: main's styleguide sha256 is 565cc7f2668d…, the pinned bytes are bc0cf7e28cd5…) — so the merge act must re-COPY the new main bytes, recompute sha256 and update source together in one deliberate commit. A re-CITATION of this pin to a main commit (source-only, claiming the same digest) is the fragile form and refuses the pin test's expectation. That re-copy is a gateway-merge step, owned here by this note.
